text:
sara: flagging FRA customs snag on AWB LH-772-555. infra says this will pinch our EU pool next week if units delayed. vendor - what are immediate routing options and any standby/insurance concessions?
atlas-ops: we can do a split: up to 10 units via next-flight air (48-72h) + remainder sea (+8 days). air premium $1.6k/unit. or consolidate to sea with 50% credit toward depot stand-by fees. need PO confirmation.
mike: if we accept partial air, depot has limited dock windows Mon-Wed. can we get temporary pallet staging? cost below.
mike: ```
staging lease (10d): $220/day area
handling per unit: $100
expedite handling (air split): $75/unit
```
shipment-bot: Update: AWB LH-772-555 status "Docs incomplete". carrier ETA flex +24h.
alexa: ops impact: without serial manifest we'll need temp serials and cross-check on receipt. that's ~1.5 FTE-days to reconcile. quarantine policy kicks after 96h.
sara: vendor - is the 50% credit guaranteed or conditional? can you instead cap standby exposure?
atlas-ops: credit is conditional on photo proof + depot invoice within 72h. alternative: we absorb depot standby up to $4k if you agree to split and confirm booking within 1h.
raul: procurement: we can greenlight air surcharge for up to 10 units. beyond 10 need stepped discounts: 11-20 units $1.4k/unit, 21+ $1.1k/unit. can you run those brackets?
atlas-ops: here's quick bracket quote: 10 air = +$16k; 20 air = +$28k; 30 air = +$39k. (includes expedited handling).
ops-bot: Reminder: staging buffer must reconcile serials within 96h or move to quarantine. Temporary-ID flow available: send CSV manifest with temp_id column.
sara: ok propose: split 10 air now, rest sea; vendor to absorb standby up to $4k; we accept +$16k delta. staging will take up to 12 units Tue-Wed; RMA pickup SLA needs to be explicit.
raul: procurement approves +$16k if vendor commit and RMA pickup SLA <= 6 business days.
atlas-ops: confirmed: RMA pickup SLA 6bd. we'll accept photo-first triage. booking in progress; will post AWB for air leg and updated sea ETA in ~90m.
mike: ops note: please include temp-ID manifest if serials missing, and CC depot photo checklist. we'll bill OT for reconciliation.
sara: thanks. vendor pls attach written confirmation of standby cap, RMA SLA, and bracket pricing to the PO amendment. :pray:
